curatedMovie.curiosityHook: With a pack of killers closing in on the highway, can the runaway lovers outrace the vindictive reach of Lula’s mother?
curatedMovie.description: Young lovers Sailor and Lula take to the open highway to build a future together, fleeing the wrath of Lula’s deranged mother, who sends a relentless squad of contract killers to bring their surreal honeymoon to an end.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, intense, and surreal road-trip thriller mixing dark criminal danger with passionate romance.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: David Lynch steers a feverish blend of crime thriller and road-trip romance, infusing an elopement with raw emotional stakes and escalating danger.
